name: Weld Fab Manufacturing Corporation
old_description: WeldFab has the equipment and expertise to produce metal fabrications for your business needs, at the level of quality you demand.
about:
Weld Fab Manufacturing Corporation operates from Slinger, Wisconsin, where it was founded in 1990 as a small weldment shop. The family-owned business began with minor welding projects and expanded steadily over the following decade.

Today the company runs a 50,000-square-foot facility equipped for sheet metal fabrication, laser cutting, turret punching, robotic and manual welding, CNC machining, tube bending, and precision forming. Its equipment roster includes multiple Amada brake presses, fiber lasers, turret punches, Miller robotic welding cells, Fadal vertical machining centers, and Miyano live-tooling lathes. The shop works with carbon steel, aluminum, stainless steel, galvanized and galvannealed sheet from 0.020 to 1.00 inch thick, and handles parts from hand-sized components to room-sized weldments.

Weld Fab serves a broad range of industrial customers, though the company does not list specific sectors on its public pages. Its capabilities are geared toward original equipment manufacturers and fabricators requiring custom metal parts, welded assemblies, and machined components.

The firm emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certified quality system, which integrates SolidWorks and Dr ABE simulation for bending validation, and uses a Romer arm with Virtek laser scanning for real-time inspection. Management says this end-to-end QC process reduces handling time, identifies material alternatives, and secures custom tooling before production starts.
